title: CardCorpus vocabulary
description: The words public/v1 uses, each with a label and, where curated, a tell: how to spot it. Roles, reprint differences, a variant's axes and distribution kinds; rarity words and how showy they are; catalogs and languages; set types and links between sets; card types and pieces. A value is never renamed: a rename adds a new value (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#vocabulary).

codeMark.description: The letters cards in the language print after the set code where they name their set: "EN" in "PBL EN", "F" in "M6a F", "C" in "CSV3C". Absent for a language whose cards print the code alone (Japanese, Korean). A set's `printedCode` is its set code with this mark (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#printed-codes).

codeMarkJoined.description: `true` where the mark is joined to the code with no space (Simplified Chinese's "C": "CSV3C"); absent where a space comes between ("PBL EN").
